audit.summary: Proposition 7.2's uniform-in-H threshold is false. Equation (62) contains invalid equalities/inequalities at the decisive divergence step for the stationary-tail lower bound. Explicit local corrections recover the intended divergence conditionally; final theorem falsity is not established.
limitations: P1 — Counterevidence: Equation (58) retains a minimum with 1 and a lower spatial threshold. For fixed H an H-dependent r cutoff suffices, and finite-cutoff changes do not affect divergence in (60).

P2 — Counterevidence: No final-theorem counterexample. The replacement integral over I_n=[c1(r_n+1+c2),c1(2r_n+c2)] is >=(3^(1-p)c1^(2-p)/2)*r_n^(s+2-p), a divergent series with positive exponent. (61) stays finite.
Counterevidence: Formal Lyapunov coefficients use the correct ratio and threshold; no core dependency on the heuristic mislabel established.
Limitations: Feller localization/irreducibility and external Harris criteria not independently certified
Limitations: Critical stability case beta=-beta_c expressly omitted by paper
Limitations: No simulated diffusion or author code execution
Limitations: No first-discovery or author-adoption claim
Limitations: Acceptance is restricted to the two reported Problems and their actual hypotheses, repairs, severity and dependencies.

Limitations: Prior broader initial-review coverage and computations remain attributed to [internal task]; no full re-review or new author-code execution was performed.

proposition.claim:
Positive constants and r0 fixed before every continuous nondecreasing H yield P(additive functional >= r)>=C/G_H(r/epsilon)^p for every r>r0.

Admissible reflected diffusion and p>1-beta/beta_c. H_K is constant positive; r_H=0. All stated constants fixed before H.

Equation (62) derives divergence from the H constructed in (61).

beta<-beta_c. eta>0; alpha=-(1+beta/beta_c)+eta; s=alpha-eta/2>0. r_(n+1)>2*r_n>2. H'=r_n^s on [r_n,r_n+1), then 1/(r_(n+1)-r_n). p in (1-beta/beta_c,1-beta/beta_c+eta/2), c1,c2>1.

repair.content:
Require r beyond epsilon*v_*^2*H(v_*) and enough that the minimum may be removed, or keep the original truncated bound and domain.

Use H(r_n+1)>=r_n^s, shift the integration intervals, retain the positive c1 factor and use inequalities. Interpret H as locally absolutely continuous; change of variables holds almost everywhere.
